## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

State the checks performed and any untested behavior.

## Animation acceptance

Complete this section when changing a scene or its event contract.
Follow `docs/200_ZETTEL/20261010-lasseter-animation-canon.md`.

- [ ] State the character's intent, key poses and visual reference.
- [ ] Explain each Lasseter principle's application or why it does not apply.
- [ ] Attach rendered evidence of the sequence and phone framing, including contact.
- [ ] Fix failed contact or unclear staging; explain any deliberate exception with evidence.
- [ ] Run the frontend build and `npm run check:animations` for animation changes.
- [ ] Record pause, replay, backward seek, reduced motion and any untested criteria.
- [ ] Verify confirmed event data and visible consequences when changing the event contract.
